plugins.name: jitx-skills
plugins.description: JITX workflow skills for PCB design. Use jitx-component-modeler for component creation from datasheets. Use jitx-circuit-builder for wiring circuits, passives, providers, and application circuits. Use jitx-substrate-modeler for capturing information about the fabrication substrate.
